_comment: Copy to config.json. No API key or cookies needed. Each showtime needs only its ID (the number in the URL /showtimes/<ID>/seats) plus a human label.
_rows_note: AMC skips row 'I'; H-N is really H,J,K,L,M,N. Listing I is harmless.
_types_note: Only these seat types count. CanReserve = standard bookable seat. Excludes Wheelchair/Companion seats, which show as available but shouldn't trigger.
